headline: Apple Announces iPhone 18 Pro & Foldable Launch Event for Sept 9
summary: Apple has officially invited press to its next major launch event, scheduled for September 9th. The "Surprise and shine" tagline hints at potential new form factors and the long-awaited foldable iPhone.
details: Apple has officially announced its next major product launch event, set to take place on September 9th at 1 PM ET. The invitations, bearing the tagline "Surprise and shine," suggest a significant unveiling.

This event is highly anticipated as it may finally see the debut of Apple's rumored foldable iPhone. Early indications point to a wide form factor, potentially similar to Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold series.

Alongside the foldable, Apple is expected to refresh its Pro and Pro Max iPhone models, likely to be named the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. However, these are anticipated to be iterative updates rather than a major redesign.

Notably, the base model iPhone 18 is reportedly not slated for announcement at this event, with its introduction possibly delayed until next year. Future rumors also mention an iPhone 18e and a second-generation iPhone Air for 2027.
This event will also mark a significant leadership transition, as John Ternus, formerly head of hardware, will assume the CEO role from Tim Cook on September 1st.
caption:

Alongside the foldable, Apple is expected to refresh its Pro and Pro Max iPhone models, likely to be named the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. However, these are anticipated to be iterative updates rather than a major redesign.

Notably, the base model iPhone 18 is reportedly not slated for announcement at this event, with its introduction possibly delayed until next year. Future rumors also mention an iPhone 18e and a second-generation iPhone Air for 2027.

This event will also mark a significant leadership transition, as John Ternus, formerly head of hardware, will assume the CEO role from Tim Cook on September 1st.
